added_lines: or all souls’ day, we pray for all those who have died. the month of november, especially all saints day and all souls’ day, is a traditional time for visiting the graves of loved ones. we are called in a special way to pray for the souls of all the faithfully departed on this day. “o lord, support us all the day long, until the shadows lengthen, and the evening comes, and the busy world is hushed, and the fever of life is over, and our work is done. then in your mercy, grant us a safe lodging, and a holy rest, and peace at the last." - john henry newman blackrock
parish priest: vrev fr john gilligan

. in november each year we take the opportunity, on share appeal sunday,6/7 november, to remind ourselves about the second collection taken up at weekend masses throughout the year. share, the diocesan development fund, depends on the generosity of parishioners. it reflects, practically, our mission, service and solidarity, responding to needs felt in parishes across the archdiocese. koins for kids our mission is to strive towards ensuring that children that suffer from illnesses and conditions beyond their control have access to the best possible equipment for their diagnosis and treatment. our charity has been working to raise funds by repatriating non- euro currencies. so far we have raised in excess of €870,000. however, much more needs to be done, and we need your help to achieve our goal. as a 100% voluntary charity 100% of your donation will go to helping these children. st brigid’s parish have been a wonderful supporter of this charity. please continue to drop all old coins and notes, any currency, in to jean in the parish office. pray for our recently deceased eamonn doyle albert johnson always loved, never forgotten pray for our recently deceased eamonn doyle albert johnson always loved, never forgotten theway.ie the way.ie is a digital platform set up by the irish catholic bishops’ conference dedicated to sharing the good news and the witness of the catholic church in ireland. it is intended to help people discover the faith, live the faith and pass on the faith. it is for both seekers and followers. visit
